text:
ravi (Marketing): Need a fresh benchmark narrative for next week's mini-launch. Outcome: 3 visuals, 1-line hooks, and inbound routing. Keep it tight and testable.

anya (Data): Proposed 3 visuals:
1) Engagement lift vs p95 latency (scatter w/ trend)
2) Token $ per 1k by batch+quant (stacked bars)
3) Reliability band: p99 vs retry cost (line+shaded)

lee (Growth): For messaging, think in buyer steps: hero -> metric -> CTA. Want short hero variants and CTA split for routing.

sam (Product): Data snippet from internal microbench (anonymized):
```
baseline: p95 310ms, tokens/$ = 0.024
optimized: p95 60ms, tokens/$ = 0.018
engagement lift: +17% task completion
estimated saving: ~22% per 1M tokens
```

ravi (Marketing): Good. Draft hooks (one-line):
- Visual1: "Tighten the tail, boost completion (~15-20% in tests)"
- Visual2: "Smart batch + quant = predictable token $ savings"
- Visual3: "Control p99 to reduce retries and hidden costs"

hana (Design): I'll produce: social card (1200x628), slide strip (1024x512), and a short GIF (p95 compress). Keep copy <90 chars for card hero.

lee (Growth): Routing modal on demo signup: "Primary goal?" (Speed | Cost | Reliability). Map to: Speed -> perf demo; Cost -> ROI calc; Reliability -> SLA chat. Track conversions by UTM.

anya (Data): Note: include footnote on assumptions: avg prompt 25 tokens, model family, token mix, quant mode. Don't overclaim.

sam (Product): Microcase for slide: "Support bot: p95 310 -> 60ms; task success +17%; net token cost -22%" (anonymized). Legal prefers "~" qualifiers.

ravi (Marketing): Hero copy variants (short):
A: "Faster replies, better outcomes — benchmarked."
B: "Cut tail latency, raise conversions."

hana (Design): I'll mock both. Which CTAs to pair?

lee (Growth): Pair A -> "Schedule a perf demo" (paid). B -> "Try our ROI calc" (organic). We'll A/B test.

infra-bot: Uploaded /benchmarks/microbench_summary.csv (sha256: 9f8c...)

ravi (Marketing): Final checklist: visuals (hana), data export + csv (anya), triage modal + routing (lee), microcase + wording (sam/legal). Drop assets by 1748890250 (EOD). I'll assemble the launch thread + webinar invite after. Thanks :rocket:
